title: Extract the documentation machinery (docs-doctor, probe executor, jot) from abacus
description: The doc-governance tooling is general-purpose but currently lives in the abacus checkout: tools/docs_doctor.py, tools/probe_executor.py (with run_bounded), tools/test_docs_doctor.py + test_probe_executor.py, and later the jot/jot-review funnel from build step 3. The governing spec (PROPOSAL-funnel-and-docs-doctor.md, operator-approved v20) is likewise general. Cross-repo operation is already demonstrated - this repo's corpus is checked by the abacus copy of docs-doctor today - but two hardcoded abacus-isms make that portability partly illusory and MUST be externalized before or during the move: (1) MODULE_RE at docs_doctor.py:34 hardcodes the abacus module-contract path shape, and (2) BEAD_RE at docs_doctor.py:37 hardcodes the bead:abacus- forward-citation prefix, so a bead:skills- citation in THIS repo is silently unchecked (verified 2026-08-12: zero such citations exist yet, which is why the cross-repo run looked clean). Both belong in the per-repo manifest or the workflow-contract adapter that skills-xg9 already specifies for north-star - one adapter concept serving skills and tools alike. Also externalize the tracker command surface (br --no-db show in the tracker_status probe and the .beads/issues.jsonl reverse-scan input) via the same adapter. SEQUENCING: do not start before abacus-42w closes - the abacus corpus retrofit is the tool's acceptance evidence and extracting mid-build strands it. OPEN SCOPE QUESTION for the operator: this repo is named and chartered for SKILLS; docs-doctor is a CLI tool, not a skill. Whether it lives here (broadening the charter to agent workflow infrastructure) or in a separate tooling repo is exactly the kind of boundary the founding NORTH-STAR.md establish-mode run (skills-xg9 item 5) should settle - run that first, then site this work per the ratified thesis. Acceptance: tools run from their new home against at least two repos with no hardcoded consumer-repo identifiers; abacus consumes them via its own adapter; the abacus copies are retired in the same landing.
notes: Portability profile differs across the three pieces (analysis 2026-08-12, operator question). jot (the capture CLI) is the MOST portable component in the whole design - queue at git-common-dir, event wire format, durability protocol, all repo-agnostic with zero consumer-repo identifiers. jot-review concentrates the tracker bindings: br create --external-ref, the br list -a --limit 0 --json reconciliation read, the ID-case convention, and the full-bar description requirement - the same adapter surface as docs-doctor's BEAD_RE/MODULE_RE and north-star's record verbs, so one adapter contract covers all three. The doc-promotion half (content-addressed patch artifacts, landing conjunction) is generic git. SEQUENCING FORK for the operator, created by jot being unbuilt: the approved build plan orders step 3 (jot + jot-review, gated on experiment 5) but does not fix its location. Option A builds it in abacus per current practice and extracts everything in one later move. Option B closes abacus-42w, extracts (this bead), then builds jot in its new home - no second extraction, and jot is written against the adapter seam from day one instead of being retrofitted onto it. B also matches jot's runtime shape: the CLI installs once and operates on whatever repository the agent is in, so building it inside a repo it will be extracted from is backwards. B is not a spec deviation - the build plan orders the work, not its address.

title: council first live acceptance run on a real contested decision
description: The council skill aligned at r5 in abacus with its first live run designated as the acceptance test - it has never run. Execute one full council on a genuinely contested decision (candidates from recent abacus work: the tree-claim TTL amendment shape, the worktree dispatch protocol, or any operator-nominated fork). The run must honor the skill contract in skills/council/SKILL.md: frozen review subject (exact commit or brief-embedded text with hash), herdr version recorded verbatim in the manifest, owner ledger initialized on disk, full reviewer responses captured into the ledger, and the brief passing the reader test (a reader given only brief.md can state the decision under review). Record every deviation the run surfaces as findings on this bead - the run is the test, so gaps are results, not embarrassments. Acceptance: completed run artifacts + a findings list; skill amendments (if any) get their own review round; README.md validation ledger updated in the landing commit.

title: north-star check-mode fixture (mode is UNTRUSTED until this lands)
description: The north-star skill aligned at r4 in abacus with check mode explicitly untrusted until a fixture exists. Build a hermetic fixture suite for check mode per the acceptance list in skills/north-star/SKILL.md (~line 170-180): the two-observation gate, verdict fold, check-record write shape (north-star-checks/<ULID>.md, never edited after creation), addenda as distinct event-ULID paths with no merge conflict, and record replay. Reuse the proven harness patterns from abacus tools/test_docs_doctor.py: temp git repos, baseline-must-be-clean design, expect_findings-style result-bound assertions, stub providers on PATH, and tools/probe_executor.py (import from the abacus checkout until the executor is extracted). Acceptance: fixture green from this repo root; the UNTRUSTED marker comes off README.md in the same commit.

title: extraction completion: workflow-contract adapter, global install, retire abacus copies
description: Complete the skills extraction from abacus. Deliverables: (1) a workflow-contract adapter spec - factor the repo-specific bindings out of skills/north-star/SKILL.md (br comments add as the append-safe record op at ~line 147, stock br create atomicity at ~line 167, the lowercase abacus ID convention, and the normative-doc list at ~line 47) into a per-consuming-repo adapter document pattern (model: the market-brief repo's agents adapter documents, its issue-tracker and domain adapters specifically; the ratified abacus taxonomy reserves the workflow-contract class for exactly this); the skill text then references the adapter, never a concrete tracker. (2) Operator installs the user-global symlinks per README.md; verify both skills load from a non-abacus cwd. (3) Retire the in-repo copies at abacus .claude/skills for north-star and council - two copies is a drift defect; abacus keeps only its adapter + NORTH-STAR.md (see abacus bead abacus-uzu for the manifest admission). (4) Decide the governance class for skill definition files in this repo docs-corpus.json - doc-meta blocks would break the skill loader frontmatter, so they need either a metadata-exempt class or sidecar rows. (5) Run north-star establish mode WITH the operator to found this repo NORTH-STAR.md - that run is establish mode acceptance evidence AND the founding thesis; do not write the file by hand. Gotchas: item 5 is interactive, schedule with the operator; item 3 only after item 2 verifies.
